verdict.rationale: Numeral has a documented REST API with per-endpoint reference pages, but the evidence shows no downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and the probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. The llms.txt index and the MCP server are adjacent AI-facing features, not machine-readable API specifications, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
